name: Gemini
tagline: US-regulated crypto exchange REST and WebSocket APIs for market data and trading
description: Gemini provides REST and WebSocket APIs for market data, order placement, account balances, and custody-related trading on its US-regulated cryptocurrency exchange. Public endpoints cover symbols, tickers, order books, and trades; private endpoints require API-key authentication for order management and account history.

auth.details: API key + secret via HMAC-SHA384 signed payload; X-GEMINI-APIKEY, X-GEMINI-PAYLOAD, X-GEMINI-SIGNATURE headers for private endpoints. Self-serve from account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access free; trading fees apply per fee schedule
pricing.paid_plans: Trading fee tiers based on 30-day volume; API itself not sold as a paid product

rate_limits: Public REST: 120 requests/minute (recommended ≤1 request/second). Private REST: 600 requests/minute (recommended ≤5 requests/second). Some endpoints have stricter documented limits.
use_cases: get BTC/USD ticker price and 24h volume
fetch order book depth for a trading pair
place and cancel limit orders on Gemini
list account balances and trade history
get recent public trade prints for a symbol
